name: PDT house ginger beer
description: PDT's house ginger beer from The PDT Cocktail Book. Makes about 20 ounces.
instructions: Boil the water, then turn off the heat. Add the minced ginger, cover and infuse for one hour.
Strain through a chinois, pressing on the ginger to extract as much liquid as possible.
Stir in the brown sugar and lime juice.
Bottle and store in the refrigerator.
